content.title: Households Brace for Rising Energy Bills
content.caption: Households brace for significant increases in energy bills due to new price caps announced by Ofgem.

slides.heading: New Price Caps Announced
slides.text: New price caps announced by Ofgem set a maximum price for each unit of energy, leading to significant increases in energy bills for households.
